scope: D newly added 8 images only; C2 8; C3 26. Previously checked D images excluded.
browser: dot cloud Chromium, Issue 4 inline rendered image elements
method: Focused each exact rendered image link to scroll it into the actual Issue page viewport, then visually inspected actual browser screenshots. The two tall images were inspected in overlapping top/bottom views. DOM complete/natural dimensions and closed-details ancestry were recorded only as supporting information, not substituted for visual inspection.
privacy: Only the article image/filename area is delivered. Screenshot crops remove GitHub account/sidebar UI. Cropping only, no rescaling, compositing, retouching, sharpening or content edits. Browser screenshot JPEG pixels are saved as lossless cropped PNGs. The browser cursor/focus border is part of capture.
limitations: Images were inspected inline in Issue 4; raw URLs were recorded but not separately visited. This is a display check, not geometric/source validation or user acceptance. No GitHub content was changed. Bilibili tab 2 was not touched. No downloads were deleted.
